heading: Regulations
lead: As soon as practicable after the effective date of this subchapter, the Secretary shall promulgate regulations appropriate for its implementation.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: The effective date of this subchapter, referred to in text, probably means the date of enactment of Pub. L. 114–289, which enacted this subchapter and was approved Dec. 16, 2016.

sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 114–289, title VII, § 701, Dec. 16, 2016, 130 Stat. 1493.)
